CREATE INDEX idx_games_homepage_recommendation_pool ON public.games USING btree (verdict_score DESC NULLS LAST, score DESC, release_date DESC) WHERE ((release_date IS NOT NULL) AND (cover_image IS NOT NULL) AND (cover_image <> ''::text) AND (score >= 75) AND (review_count >= 75) AND (confidence >= (0.4)::double precision))

CREATE INDEX idx_games_homepage_top_rated_pool ON public.games USING btree (verdict_score DESC NULLS LAST, confidence DESC NULLS LAST, score DESC, release_date DESC) WHERE ((release_date IS NOT NULL) AND (cover_image IS NOT NULL) AND (cover_image <> ''::text) AND (score >= 70) AND (review_count >= 75) AND (confidence >= (0.3)::double precision))
